benchmark.rule: The v6 benchmark series is a separate dataset under research/data/candles_v6, bounded at the v6 development cutoff. configs/research_v6.json -> holdout.benchmark_rule requires the benchmark dataset to be bounded at the v6 development cutoff and to be bound by its recomputed content hash in the v6 execution protocol. The v5 chain's dataset (research/data/candles_v5/BTCUSDT_1h_626e639b02e54bc1.csv) covers the identical span and its last candle closes exactly at the v6 cutoff, so the v6 chain fetches its own copy of the same bounded window and every v6 artifact lives in the v6 namespace.

code_hash_note: code_hash is the authorized value of record for the hashed set, cross-checked against research_state/campaign_authorization.json; canonical_source_digest is the portable identity of the tree.

confirmatory_window.note: No confirmatory-window candle has been read. The v6 confirmatory window starts after the v6 candidate freeze and needs at least 2160 closed hourly candles, so it cannot be evaluated in this session. Neither the v1 holdout, nor the v2, v3, v4 or v5 confirmatory windows are reused, and no development candle closes after the preregistered development cutoff: the last development candle is the one that closes exactly at the cutoff, so it contains no instant inside any open confirmatory window.

window_membership_rule.rule: a candle is inside a confirmatory window when its close falls strictly after that window's start and before its end, regardless of which asset the candle belongs to; a candle that closes exactly at a window's start is development data
window_membership_rule.source_quote: Candles that close at or before confirmatory_window_start_utc are development data and may inform selection.

specification_flag.resolution: the v6 specification was written with the corrected rule: a candle that closes exactly at a window's start is development data, and the v6 development cutoff is the v2 window's start. No amendment is needed for the v6 chain

data_source.endpoint_policy: same-provider failover; selected endpoint recorded per asset

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the manifest body with manifest_hash and snapshot_identity.data_manifest_hash removed, so that the manifest can carry the data-manifest hash without hashing itself into a cycle.

notes: v6 data manifest. Every accepted asset references an immutable canonical hourly CSV dataset under research/data/candles_v6. Synthetic records are never permitted. Nothing here is a research result: no grid, backtest, campaign or candidate selection has been run under v6.

prerequisite_status.note: configs/research_v6.json is immutable and still records P2 and P3 as OUTSTANDING; that statement describes the specification's own scope at freeze time and is not rewritten here. Flipping it requires a versioned amendment to the specification.

supersedes.note: The v5 data manifest is immutable and is not edited by this version; the v6 data manifest is the next band below the recomputed v5 floor.

window_policy.boundary_convention: inclusive: the last development candle is the one that closes exactly at the development cutoff, and no candle that closes after the cutoff is read or accepted
window_policy.note: The candle window ends at the last fully closed hour at the preregistered development cutoff (configs/research_v6.json#holdout.development_cutoff_utc), so no v6 development dataset contains a candle that closes inside the open v2, v3, v4 or v5 confirmatory window, and re-running the validation reproduces byte-identical datasets.
